_comment: TEMPLATE, INTENTIONALLY ALREADY EXPIRED. Every rate below is a placeholder (0.0), and 'expires' is set in the past on purpose so cost.py's own loader refuses to compute anything until you replace these values. That refusal is the intended first-run experience, not a bug. Verify every figure against the pricing and prompt-caching pages, then set verified/expires/source and a dated provenance entry per fact. cost.py warns on any fact older than 30 days and refuses past 90.

notes.cache_read_mult: Per-model cache-hit multiplier; omit the key to use multipliers.cache_read. Some models list their own (check the prompt-caching page).
notes.tokenizer_factor: Tokens per previous-generation token. Anthropic documents ~30% more tokens for Claude 4.7 and later (1.3); use 1.0 for earlier models. Omitted keys default to 1.3, the conservative direction.
notes.tool_overhead: System-prompt tokens added to every tool-enabled request: 'auto' for tool_choice auto/none, 'any' for any/tool. Omit a key the pricing page does not list; cost.py raises rather than assuming zero.
notes.region_us_only: Data-residency multiplier on every token category where the provider charges one. Confirm on the pricing page.
notes.long_context_surcharge: 1.0 where the full context window bills at standard rates. Leave null until confirmed; a null modifier is excluded and named in every output.
notes.cache_min_tokens: Omit the key for any model whose minimum is neither documented nor measured; a guess must never be readable as fact.
notes.region_us: Set "region_us": false on a model where data-residency pricing does not apply (Anthropic lists it for Claude 4.6 and later); cost.py then raises rather than pricing region 'us'.
